title: Orbit search equals arithmetic search
statement: For natural numbers $C,e$ and every Boolean word $w$, searching the indices from $0$ through $|w|$ for the first index at which the split acceptance test holds on the corresponding iterate of the split step gives the same result as the arithmetic search for the least $i\in\{0,\ldots,|w|\}$ satisfying $i+C(i+1)^e=|w|$, with no result when no such index exists.
replaced:
For all $C$ and $e$ and every word $w$, searching the indices
$0, \dots, \abs{w}$ for the first $i$ at which the split-acceptance test
succeeds on the $i$-th iterate of the split step returns exactly the
arithmetic split search at parameters $C$, $e$, and $\abs{w}$, i.e.\ the
least $i$ with $i + C\,(i+1)^{e} = \abs{w}$ when one exists and nothing
otherwise.
